notes:
- New name, new mark, new look. The launcher, the in-game menu and the resource pack all carry it.
- A new texture pack: blocks, items, the interface and every mod GUI, in one pack instead of two.
- An update now opens a window that tells you what changed before you install it.
- While an update downloads you can see how far along it is, how fast it is going, and how much longer it has to run.
- Your accounts, instances, worlds, mods and settings come across on their own. There is nothing to reinstall.
- The old menu jar and the old resource packs are taken out of every instance, so nothing is loaded twice.
